invention.ref: Bow shears appear in Europe around 1000 BCE
invention.ref_zh: 约公元前 1000 年欧洲出现弓形剪

mass_production.ref: Robert Hinchliffe of Sheffield makes cast-steel scissors for the mass market
mass_production.ref_zh: 谢菲尔德的欣奇利夫生产面向大众的铸钢剪刀

notes: 早期的是弹簧式弓形剪，支轴式剪刀后来才普及。杭州张小泉创立于 1663 年，创始人张思家早在约 1580 年（明代）就开创了这种镶钢工艺。
summary_zh: 弓形剪约公元前 1000 年出现在欧洲；1761 年谢菲尔德的欣奇利夫开始量产铸钢剪刀；杭州张小泉自 1663 年制作支轴剪。
summary_en: Bow shears appeared in Europe around 1000 BCE; Robert Hinchliffe of Sheffield mass-produced cast-steel scissors in 1761; Hangzhou's Zhang Xiaoquan has made pivoted scissors since 1663.
summary_ja: 弓形の大ばさみは紀元前1000年頃のヨーロッパに現れた。シェフィールドの Robert Hinchliffe は1761年に鋳鋼のはさみを量産し、杭州の張小泉は1663年から軸のはさみを作っている。
notes_en: Early shears were spring-type bow shears; pivoted scissors came later. Hangzhou's Zhang Xiaoquan was founded in 1663, and founder Zhang Sijia pioneered its inlaid-steel design around 1580 in the Ming dynasty.
